name: spin-gentle-180
description: Sensorless start profile matched to the 180 rad/s el handoff + 1.2 s ramp (the old prof-hold/spin-gentle punch-then-drop at t=1.0 lands the current drop MID-ramp now, collapsing the capture torque and leaving the rotor hunting - that wrecked the observer and produced the hold-ratchet readings). Constant 0.5 A through deadshort + full ramp + hold/confirm (t=0.5..3.2), then the standard 0.3 A cruise, unload at 8.
